#include <iostream>
#include <vector>

using namespace std;

int main() {
    int w, m;
    cin >> w >> m;

    vector<int> digits;
    while (m != 0) {
        digits.push_back(m % w);
        m /= w;
    }

    bool ok = true;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < digits.size(); ++i) {
        int d = digits[i];
        if (d == 0 || d == 1) {
            continue;
        }
        if (d == w - 1) {
            size_t j = i + 1;
            while (j < digits.size()) {
                if (digits[j] == w - 1) {
                    digits[j] = 0;
                } else {
                    digits[j] += 1;
                    break;
                }
                ++j;
            }
            continue;
        }
        ok = false;
        break;
    }

    if (ok) {
        cout << "YES" << endl;
    } else {
        cout << "NO" << endl;
    }

    return 0;
}
